**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation mechanic in either direction. I checked the planner's candidate sections (§ 11 Fees, § 10 Maintenance and Support, § 20 General Matters) plus the related pricing hooks in § 2 and § 17, and ran searches for "most favoured/favorable", "no less favourable", "best price", "other customers", "discount" and "exclusive" — none surface any MFN or price-matching language. Pricing is handled entirely by reference to the Fee Schedule.

Since this is a direction rule, the absence of any MFN means Sparkling carries no obligation to extend Garman terms given to third parties, which sits at the preferred position. Worth noting for the deal team: there is equally no MFN in *our* favour, so if best-pricing protection is commercially important, it would have to be negotiated into the Fee Schedule separately — that is an ask, not a defect in the current draft.
